notes.title: The game will no longer be available for sale.
notes.content: [p]This game was developed with an older version of Unity and may have compatibility issues on newer operating systems (Windows 11). Therefore, this game will no longer be available for sale.[/p][p]Thank you very much for your support.[/p]

notes.title: Devil's Dungeon is now released! (with 20% sale off)
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are very happy to announce that Devil's Dungeon is ready for buy right now with a 20% off launch sale!
